flashcards.back: Define cultural practices, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define heritage, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define ideas and traditions, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define continuity and change, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore cultural practices
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on cultural practices. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where heritage is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach continuity and change to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
